intro.title: Aquamarine Stone
intro.description: Aquamarine has been admired since antiquity—Romans, Greeks, and Egyptians prized this crystalline blue stone. "Aqua" is the Latin word for water, and "marine" means "of the sea," signifying Aquamarine's connection to ancient water kingdoms. Aquamarine is a popular gemstone for jewelry design due to its beautiful translucent pale turquoise color. Due to its association with the ocean, the Aquamarine crystal meaning functions to clear and purify the water element inside our bodies, which is essential to our health and well-being. Aquamarine's properties help remove emotional toxicity and promote feelings of inner peace by reconnecting us to the earth's life-giving water element.

tabs.tab1_description:
Aquamarine gemstone has a naturally pastel light blue color; bright and soft, the color of aquamarine is particularly popular with lovers of blue colored gemstones. Aquamarine belongs to the Beryl family, they are found all over the world, from the US to Africa to India. The most productive and well-known mines of Aquamarine are undoubtedly found in Brazil. Rated between 7.5 to 8 on the Mohs hardness scale, aquamarine is one of the most robust and resistant semi-precious stones on the planet.

Due to its association with the oceans, aquamarine gemstones are believed to provide protection, sailors used to believe that carrying the gemstone with them ensures a safe and prosperous passage across stormy seas. Also due to its association with mystic benefits such as happiness, youth and hope, aquamarine gemstones are ever increasingly being chosen to be set in engagement rings.

Aquamarine's calming, go-with-the-flow frequencies make it an excellent crystal healing tool. In addition to calming and balancing the Vishuddha chakra, it enhances immunity by facilitating the flow of energy between the Thymus and Throat energy centers. Water is also associated with the Aquamarine stone meaning, which gives it a cooling effect on the body. When you infuse water with Aquamarine properties, you can use it to cleanse and balance the Throat chakra anytime you need to recharge and renew.

Invoking the legends of sailors and seafarers, this gem is used as a protective talisman for fortunate circumstances and a strong sense of fearlessness for an upcoming trip across the high seas. Aquamarine is a must-have luck stone with numerous healing properties for those who travel frequently by water or reside near water. If you long for water but live far from it, the Aquamarine meaning will always keep you connected to the ocean's beauty and healing power.

Aquamarine is fantastic for calming frayed nerves, as it helps to channel the calming properties of the ocean and other bodies of water. With its extraordinary anti-aging properties, the Aquamarine crystal meaning is also associated with restoring the vitality and beauty of youth. You can access the healing properties of aquamarine, rejuvenate your complexion and aura by wearing this stress-relieving stone that restores tranquility.

Aquamarine enhances eloquence and aids in overcoming fear and reluctance when communicating with others. It helps the individual express themselves clearly and communicate their emotions. It instills confidence, plays a crucial role in stabilizing and stimulating the thymus cycle, and ensures a person's internal health and functioning.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Aquamarine gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Aquamarine. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Thymus Chakra and also Vishuddha Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for connection with higher and spiritual self. One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with peace and tranquility in one’s life. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Aquamarine is one of the traditional lucky stones. It has the power to bring good fortune and prosperity to the wearer. It also enhances intuition, which can help you make better decisions in life. Aquamarine is a courageous stone that will enable you to confidently face any challenge. In addition, it aids in overcoming fear and anxiety, making it an ideal stone for those who suffer from attacks of panic or other mental illnesses.

Aquamarine is an excellent stone for speakers, writers, artists, and musicians who want to expand their creative abilities. It is also a mental and emotional coolant for difficult or bad tempers. It is highly recommended for those who live or work in high-stress environments or in potentially toxic industries. Aquamarine shields the body from all kinds of negative and impure influences by dissolving them before they enter the system.

Also known as Sea stone due to its ocean hues, it is also a very sought after gemstone to make engagement rings, because its high hardness is close to diamonds. It is also decidedly recommended for all people born in the month of March.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Aquamarine gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Aquamarine gemstones.

Aquamarine Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Brazil has been the leading source of aquamarine of gem-quality for over a century. It is found in both pegmatites and alluvial deposits in that region. Afghanistan, Kenya, Madagascar, Malawi, Mozambique, Nigeria, Pakistan, Russia, Tanzania, and Zambia are all sources of aquamarine gemstone. India and Sri Lanka have a lengthy history of producing aquamarine from alluvial deposits. Aquamarine has also been discovered in numerous locations across the United States.

Observe their Color:

Aquamarine gemstones are famous for their beautiful variety of blue hues, which range from a light, almost translucent blue to a rich, profound blue. In its natural state, aquamarine is typically blue with green undertones. Darker, more vibrant colors are higher priced and are more desirable. Its hues are like those of deep oceans.

Notice their Clarity:

Best quality aquamarine gemstones have total clarity, they are soft and the nearly transparent hue makes it very easy to see through them. A high quality piece of aquamarine gemstone is so near perfect that it sparkles almost like a diamond.

Examine their Inclusions:

The most valuable aquamarine will be free of visible inclusions. In comparison to its cousin emerald, aquamarine possesses superior clarity and transparency. This produces a stronger and more stable stone. Less inclusions and impurities within the crystal, the greater the stone's clarity and desirability.

See their Shape:

Aquamarine comes in a wide range of shapes that correspond to their color. The intensity of the gem's blue color increases with its size and shape. Finding a small gem with a deep and intense blue hue can be difficult, but as the size of the stone increases, so does the likelihood of discovering a gem shaped in a vibrant blue hue.

Check the Carats:

For Aquamarine of gem quality, the raw Aquamarine is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Aquamarine weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Aquamarine is sold by weight, Aquamarine prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Aquamarine has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Aquamarine

Due to treatments the Aquamarine stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Aquamarine do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Aquamarine gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Aquamarine are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Aquamarine from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Aquamarine gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Aquamarine gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Aquamarine is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).

Color

The best quality Aquamarine are clear crystalline blue in color with vivid and vibrant color saturation and tone that is not too dark or light. The color should be evenly distributed with no visible color-zone. The most valuable color of the gem is a dark blue that ranges from slightly green blue with moderately intense hue. In general, the value of aquamarine gemstone increases with the purity and intensity of its blue color.

Cut

Aquamarines can be fashioned into nearly any shape, but they are typically fashioned into emerald cuts or round or oval brilliants. The rough is abundant, and thus well-cut stones are common. The gemstone's durability and transparency make it a favorite among designers, sculptors, and artists. Aquamarine is used by gem sculptors for imaginative cutting and decorative objects.

Carat

Aquamarine of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Aquamarine are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Aquamarine rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

The majority of cut aquamarines are eye-clean. Some aquamarine crystals may contain liquid inclusions, but clarity characteristics are uncommon or nonexistent in the vast majority of completed gems. Inclusion-bearing stones are typically fashioned into cabochons, pendants, or carvings.

Dealers deal in Aquamarine stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Aquamarine gemstone Price

The price of aquamarine is primarily determined by its weight and color intensity. Gemstones with a faint blue hue are abundant and affordable. Aquamarine gemstones with a deep blue hue are considerably more expensive due to the rarity of aquamarine with a deep blue hue. A small aquamarine with a deep blue hue will cost significantly more than an identically sized stone with a pale blue hue.

Aquamarine stone prices are not excessively high, but rather moderate. For making jewelry, Aquamarine stone beads, artifacts, and other similar items, the Aquamarine stone price per kilogram is economical for all who purchase Aquamarine stone at wholesale.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Aquamarine has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Aquamarine stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Aquamarine gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 3,000 to INR 25,800 (USD 37.50 to USD 322).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Aquamarine?

The best way to check the authenticity of Aquamarine is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Aquamarine are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Aquamarine carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that Aquamarine is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Aquamarine have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Aquamarine, but if you find flaws, then your Aquamarine is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Aquamarine is glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Aquamarine. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Aquamarine, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Aquamarine from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Aquamarine. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Aquamarine. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Aquamarine Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

Aquamarine is a gemstone known for its deep blue hue and curative qualities. It is also a powerful stone, so you will need to take care of it if you want it to continue working as effectively as possible.

You will need pure water, a bowl or container suitable for holding this water (such as a glass), and an eye dropper or pipette. If you have access to either, you can use tap water or bottled spring water; just make sure it is not heavily chlorinated or treated with other chemicals that could harm your aquamarine. Pour at least two inches of pure water into the bowl or container before placing the aquamarine inside.
